description: Per-logical-schema consumer coverage. A schema that only compiles has no proven wire consumer; this report separates operation request/response binding, admitted Event contracts, structural $ref use and conformance vector coverage so an unused schema cannot hide behind a startup compile.

consumer_definitions.inbound: bound as an operation request body, or an admitted Event envelope/payload contract.
consumer_definitions.outbound: bound as an operation response body.
consumer_definitions.schema_reference: referenced by another schema document, so it is a structural component; local self-reference is not a consumer.
consumer_definitions.event_kind: bound by the Event kind registry, so a durable Event selects it by kind.
consumer_definitions.declared_wire: explicit machine-readable runtime, dynamic, nested-value or alias binding declared by the canonical schema registry.
consumer_definitions.prose_only: explicitly declared as having no whole-object v1 wire admission surface.
consumer_definitions.vectors: required by a conformance profile or vector group, or referenced by a fixture.
consumer_definitions.prose: named by the normative text, which is where a runtime-dispatched contract is defined.
consumer_definitions.startup_compile: a schema registry row, compiled by the startup catalog gate.

binding_kind_definitions.exact: the reference targets this logical schema itself.
binding_kind_definitions.fragment: the reference targets a $defs fragment of the same document.
binding_kind_definitions.registered: the schema ID appears in the Event kind registry.
binding_kind_definitions.required_schema: listed in a conformance profile or vector group required_schemas.
binding_kind_definitions.fixture: the schema ID appears in a conformance fixture.
binding_kind_definitions.normative_text: the schema ID appears in the normative prose.
binding_kind_definitions.declared: the canonical schema registry carries an explicit disposition.

vector_coverage_disposition_definitions.direct: named by a conformance profile/vector group or fixture.
vector_coverage_disposition_definitions.operation_e2e_owned: the logical schema is an operation catalog/DTO whose instance cases belong to the listed request/response E2E owners.
vector_coverage_disposition_definitions.composed_schema_owned: the schema is only admitted inside the listed higher-level logical schemas.
vector_coverage_disposition_definitions.event_envelope_owned: the payload is selected by Event kind and is covered only inside signed Event admission.
vector_coverage_disposition_definitions.runtime_dispatch_owned: the schema is selected by an explicit dynamic/runtime binding in the canonical schema registry.
vector_coverage_disposition_definitions.no_v1_wire_instance: the canonical registry explicitly declares that v1 has no whole-object wire instance.
vector_coverage_disposition_definitions.unresolved: no direct vector or reviewed higher-level coverage owner has been identified; this is a release blocker.
